Play strict Whiz Spades to win your partnership game to 300. Four seats; partner opposite. Bid nil (0) or exactly your spade count. Nil +/-100; no blind nil or table talk. Positive contracts: at least the team bid, +10/bid trick if made, -10/bid trick if set. Extra tricks +1 point/bag; ten bags -100. Nil tricks never help partner contract; failed-nil tricks are bags even when partner is set. Follow suit; spades trump. Do not lead spades until broken unless only spades remain. Ace high. Use only your private hand and public information below. Select the zero-based index of your preferred legal action. Return only {"choice": integer}. No explanation.
